# Aronica

> The physical hand of a personal AI assistant in Milano. When software can't finish, Aronica dispatches a verified local person or small business at a fixed price, with proof: car wash (pick-up & return or mobile wash), waiting at home for a technician or courier, local pick-up & drop-off (pharmacy, keys, envelope; max 3 km), IKEA assembly and small handyman jobs. Business staffing is experimental.

- MCP (Streamable HTTP): /mcp with Authorization: Bearer <api key> (demo: ak_demo_milano)
- REST: /v1, OpenAPI 3.1 at /openapi.json
- OpenAI/xAI function schemas: /v1/tools.json
- Human-readable guide: /docs

Flow: compile_task (structured job, fixed price, open questions; mode now|scheduled) -> search_supply (who is available, ranked) -> create_job -> negotiate | auto_negotiate (A2A on WHEN, never on price) -> accept_quote -> human confirms via confirm_url -> timed offer to the best partner, cascade on decline/timeout -> wait_for_update -> get_job (proof) -> rate_worker.

Out of scope (e.g. lessons/teachers such as Capoeira), other cities, errands beyond 3 km, or no available verified partners fail closed with: "Siamo spiacenti ma al momento non abbiamo persone sufficienti a soddisfare la richiesta." plus a reason (e.g. "fuori ambito v1"). No fake matches.

Simulated in this build: supplier agents (server-side), seed partners, escrow/payments, KYC.
